n: BC Ministry AI teaching story integrating AI into the arts (grades 10-12)
t: A teaching story where drama and English students talk with an AI character chatbot.
steps: Find the Integrating AI Into the Arts teaching story from the BC Ministry.
Confirm which AI tools your district approves.
Prepare a slideshow that explains the task.
Arrange devices for research and small group use.
Run the chatbot activity as a whole class first.
Ask students to research a figure from verified sources before the chat.
Tell students to cite the tool in any performance.
